notes.title: The Extended Version
notes.notes:
A major update is in the works at Pencilgun and a new extended version of the game will be released soon. The original game in its current state is too short and more story, characters and a more satisfying ending is being added. 
When the new build is ready this game will auto update when Steam is launched and the price will stay the same. If you already purchased the game you will not be charged for the update.
